shortDescription: Create and manage Koji archive types

options.name: description
options.description: The human-readable description of this Koji archive type.  Koji uses this value in the UI tooling that display a build's files. Examples: "Debian source control file", "OpenWrt package".

options.name: extensions
options.description: The file extensions for this Koji archive type. For example, "dsc" means Koji will apply this archive type to files that end in ".dsc". "opk" will apply to files that end in ".opk", etc.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Koji archive type to create and manage. Examples: "dsc", "opk".
